2607.13883.title: Verifying formulas for interventional distributions
2607.13883.paper_summary: We formalize verification in causal graphical models: deciding whether a given observational formula identifies a target interventional distribution. This opens a problem complementary to identification, asking not whether any identifying formula exists, but whether the given formula is identifying. We show that even sound and complete solutions to identification do not solve verification. We propose a falsifier as a first practical route forward, prove that it induces an almost-surely correct verifier for regular exponential-family models, and use the resulting verifier to develop the gateway test, which finds all sets admissible for use in a front-door formula.
2607.13883.paper_summary_zh: 我們在因果圖模型中形式化驗證：決定給定的觀察公式是否識別目標干預分佈。這開啟了一個與識別互補的問題，詢問的不是是否存在任何識別公式，而是給定的公式是否為識別公式。我們展示了即使是對識別的健全和完整解決方案也無法解決驗證。我們提出了一個反駁者作為向前的第一個實際途徑，證明它為常規指數族模型引入了一個幾乎肯定正確的驗證者，並利用所得到的驗證者開發了網關測試，該測試找出所有可用於前門公式的可接受集合。
2607.13883.author: Francesco Freni et.al.
2607.13883.authors: Francesco Freni, Leonard Henckel, Sebastian Weichwald
